descriptions.description: Both subspecies of Andryala crithmifolia are classified as Critically Endangered (CR) according to the IUCN Red List Categories and criteria because of their small populations and various kinds of human pressure on its sites of occurrence.

Andryala crithmifolia occurs only in the south coast of Madeira; the typical subspecies is known only from Pináculo (E of Funchal), subsp. coronopifolia only from a single population at Cabo Girão (W of Funchal) but probably had a wider distribution in the past, having also occurred W of Cabo Girão (at Pta. do Sol, compare type collection).
